title: Aloo Gobi
description: Potatoes and cauliflower stir-fried with turmeric, cumin and coriander — a dry, everyday sabzi that comes together with pantry staples.
steps: Heat oil in a wide pan or kadhai over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the potato cubes and cook for 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to turn golden at the edges.
Add the cauliflower florets and stir to combine.
Sprinkle in the turmeric, coriander powder, red chilli powder and salt. Toss well so the vegetables are evenly coated.

Cover and cook on low-medium heat for 15-18 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the potatoes and cauliflower are fork-tender — this stays a dry sabzi, no added water needed as the vegetables release their own moisture.
Sprinkle over the garam masala, toss once more, and garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
